title: Brush Art Recalls WIC Nutrition Plates Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The plates are incorrectly labeled as microwave-safe. They contain aluminum, which poses a fire hazard if microwaved. Units: About 98,000.

title: Kawasaki USA Recalls Off-Highway Utility Vehicles Due to Fuel Leak, Fire Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The vehicle's oil cooler hoses can separate and the fuel tank cap gasket can crack allowing fuel to leak, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 2,600.

title: O'Brien Watersports Recalls Water Skis Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The skis can detach from the binding during a fall, allowing the ski to break, posing an injury hazard to the user Units: About 3,560 (in addition, about 700 were sold in Canada).

title: Tech Gear 5.7 Recalls Performance Heated Socks Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The lithium-ion battery can overheat, melt or ignite when charged with a charger other than the one provided with the product, posing fire and burn hazards to the user. Units: 4000.

title: H-E-B Recalls Sauté Pans Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The glass lid can crack or shatter during normal use, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 12,000.

title: HP Expands Recall of Batteries for Notebook Computers and Mobile Workstations Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The lithium-ion batteries can overheat, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 78,500 (In addition 50,000 were previously recalled in the U.S. in January 2018.).

title: TJX Recalls Heating Pads Due to Fire and Burn Hazards; Sold Exclusively at T.J. Maxx and Marshalls Stores
summary: The heating pads can overheat during use, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 5,600 (in addition, about 3,600 were sold in Canada).

title: Arctic Cat Recalls Textron Off-Highway Utility Vehicles Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The lower front suspension arm can fail, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 700 (In addition, about 70 were sold in Canada.).

title: Arctic Cat Recalls Textron Off-Highway Utility Vehicles Due to Fuel Leak and Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Fuel can leak from the fuel line, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 200.

title: Interline Brands Recalls Swivel Fittings Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The fittings can leak, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 140,000.

title: Midwest-CBK Recalls Baby Rattle Socks Due to Choking Hazard
summary: Small ornaments can detach from the socks, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 22,600 (in addition, about 2,600 were sold in Canada).

title: Cambridge Elevating Recalls Home Elevators Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The landing door on the elevators can unlock without the elevator present, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 680 (in addition, about 1700 were sold in Canada).

title: Rechargeable Power Banks Recalled by Daniel M. Friedman & Associates Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The power banks can overheat, posing a fire hazard Units: About 170,500 (In addition, 6,900 were sold in Canada).

title: Air King America Recalls Wall-Mounted Range Hoods Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The wall mounting anchors provided with the range hoods do not adequately secure the hood to the wall, posing an injury hazard to the consumer. Units: About 5,000 (In addition, about 3,240 were sold in Canada).

title: Alpha Guardian Recalls Stack-On Gun Safes Due to Lock Failure and Injury Hazard
summary: A bolt malfunction can cause the safe to open without the use of a key or combination, allowing access to any firearms stored inside, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 1,250.

title: Bulk Unlimited Recalls Children's Globes Due to Fire and Burn Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The globe's internal wires can short out and overheat, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 3,000.

title: American Honda Recalls Portable Generators Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The portable generator can leak gasoline from the fuel valve, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 200,000.

title: Kubota Recalls Zero Turn Mowers Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The throttle cable can make contact with internal electric wiring, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 3,850.

title: myStromer Recalls Electric Bicycles Due to Crash and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The bicycle stem can break, posing crash and injury hazards to the rider. Units: About 195.

title: Weatherbeeta USA Recalls Riding Saddles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The recalled saddles were manufactured with screws that were too short, causing the girth of the saddle to detach from the tree of the saddle, posing a fall hazard to the rider. Units: About 1,600 (In addition, about 70 were sold in Canada).
